# ghost_organization_teams (Data Source)

Lists every team in an organization, with each team's member and repository counts. Look a team up with the `ghost_team` data source for its members and repositories.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ghost_organization_teams" "all" {
  organization = "my-org"
}

# Look up every team in full, keyed by slug.
data "ghost_team" "each" {
  for_each = { for t in data.ghost_organization_teams.all.teams : t.slug => t.id }

  organization = "my-org"
  id           = each.value
}

output "team_ids" {
  value = { for t in data.ghost_organization_teams.all.teams : t.slug => t.id }
}

output "team_members" {
  value = { for slug, t in data.ghost_team.each : slug => [for m in t.members : m.username] }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) The slug of the organization. Ghost matches it case-insensitively. The token's user must be a member of the organization: Ghost answers as if any other organization didn't exist.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organization slug, as configured.
- `teams` (Attributes List) The organization's teams, sorted by slug. Empty when the organization has none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--teams))

<a id="nestedatt--teams"></a>
### Nested Schema for `teams`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The team's ID. It never changes, and is what `team_id` arguments and the `id` argument of the `ghost_team` data source take.
- `member_count` (Number) How many members the team has, maintainers included.
- `name` (String) The team's display name.
- `repository_count` (Number) How many organization repositories the team has a role on.
- `slug` (String) The team's URL-safe name, used in URLs and `@org/team` mentions. It changes when the team is renamed.
